programs.new.title: Add program
programs.new.descriptionSources: Enter the scope by hand or import the scope file from the program page. In-scope targets become scope entries that take effect when you accept the program rules; out-of-scope items stop program entries only, never your own scope.
programs.source.title: Where is the scope?
programs.source.manualHint: Paste or type the scope list from the program page.
programs.source.fileHint: The scope file the platform lets you download: CSV export, Burp Suite scope or any CSV.
programs.source.noCredentials: Private and invite-only programs work the same way: nothing is fetched from the platform and no password, cookie or token is needed.
programs.visibility.title: Who can see this program
programs.visibility.privateHint: Only program members and organization owners; each person accepts the terms first. Every view is audited.
programs.visibility.publicHint: Program members and everyone who sees the whole organization.
programs.file.label: Scope file
programs.file.tooLarge: The file is larger than 256 KiB.
programs.file.hint: A Burp Suite host expression is imported only when it names one host or one domain and its subdomains; anything wider is listed as not scannable. Nothing is created before you accept the preview.
programs.locked.title: Private program
programs.locked.body: Its scope, rules and link are shown only to members who accepted its current terms and confidentiality. Your acceptance is recorded with your name, and every view of this program is audited.
programs.locked.noTerms: No terms were entered for this program; follow the terms on its platform.
programs.locked.attest: I accept these terms and keep this program and its scope confidential (terms {hash}).
programs.pending.applied: The new scope is in effect
programs.pending.title: New scope found by the last sync
programs.pending.hint: Nothing is added until someone accepts the new terms. Removals were already applied.
programs.pending.loadFailed: The pending terms could not be loaded.
programs.pending.attest: I accept the program new rules and scope as shown above (terms {hash}). The new entries take effect at once; this acceptance is recorded with my name.
programs.source.publicHint: Pick a published program; its scope stays up to date from the program feed.
programs.form.name: Program name
programs.form.scopeHint: Paste the program scope: one target per line, with "In scope" and "Out of scope" headings (or a leading "-" for out of scope), or the program CSV export.
programs.form.windowsHint: One window per line: days, start-end and the time zone, for example "mon-fri 09:00-17:00 Europe/Paris". Outside every window, scans of this program wait. None: any time.
programs.form.badWindows: Lines {lines} are not "days HH:MM-HH:MM time zone".
programs.form.attest: I accept this program rules and scope as shown above (terms {hash}). Its entries take effect at once, without an approver; this acceptance is recorded with my name.
programs.preview.excluded: Out of scope for program entries
programs.preview.summary: {create} entries will be added, {covered} already exist, {refused} are refused; {exclusions} program exclusions ({overlaps} overlap your own scope). Probes allowed up to {tier}.
programs.source.closed: The program is closed at its source: it was suspended.
programs.source.synced: Synced: {removed} entries removed, {excluded} exclusions added, {added} additions waiting for acceptance.
programs.source.urlHint: An https file on the program own domain (the domain of its policy URL).
programs.source.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored token
programs.catalog.hint: Following a program creates its scope entries inactive: only passive monitoring runs until someone accepts its rules and scope on the program page. Scope changes from the feed reach the program; new targets wait for a new acceptance.
programs.catalog.emptyHint: The public program catalog is empty or nothing matches. The platform operator configures the program feed.
programs.catalog.counts: {in} in scope, {out} out of scope; from {source}, {date}
programs.title: Programs
programs.description: Bug-bounty and disclosure programs you test under their published rules. Their targets are scanned only from your own sensors.
programs.empty.title: No programs yet
programs.empty.description: Import a program by pasting its scope; its in-scope targets become scope entries and its out-of-scope items program exclusions.
programs.col.name: Program
programs.acceptHint: Only passive monitoring runs until someone accepts this program rules and scope (terms {hash}); its entries authorize no active scan until then.
programs.reactivateHint: Suspended: its entries authorize nothing. Reactivating accepts the program terms again (terms {hash}).
programs.reattest: I accept this program rules and scope again
programs.source.kinds.program_file: Scope file on the program domain
programs.suggestions.title: Suggested targets ({count})
programs.suggestions.hint: The feed suggests these targets but the program did not publish them as its own scope. They are never scanned unless you confirm that they belong to the program; confirming asks for a new acceptance of the terms.
programs.suggestions.done: Targets confirmed: accept the terms again to test them
programs.catalog.countsSuggested: {in} in scope, {suggested} suggested, {out} out of scope; from {source}, {date}
programs.catalog.platformNotice: Listed by {platform}: the data comes from that platform and stays subject to its terms.
